text: {"items":[{"prompt":"When a browser requests https://example.com/blog/5/, what does the Django server do regarding previous requests?","kind":"mcq","options":["It generates a response based only on the current request","It uses data from the previous request to fill missing fields","It stores the request in a session for later use","It redirects to the homepage automatically"],"correct_answer":"It generates a response based only on the current request","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"It uses data from the previous request to fill missing fields":"server-remembers-requests"}},{"prompt":"A user submits a POST request to create a new blog post. Which statement about the server’s knowledge of the user’s earlier GET request is true?","kind":"mcq","options":["Server uses previous GET request data automatically","Server infers previous GET request without extra data","Server processes each request independently unless state is sent","Server caches previous request and reuses it"],"correct_answer":"Server processes each request independently unless state is sent","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"Server uses previous GET request data automatically":"server-remembers-requests","Server infers previous GET request without extra data":"server-remembers-requests"}},{"prompt":"After a user logs in, they navigate to their profile page. How does the server know which user is making the request?","kind":"mcq","options":["Because the server remembers the login request","Because the browser includes a session cookie with the request","Because the server stores the user's IP address from the login","Because the server queries the database for the last logged-in user"],"correct_answer":"Because the browser includes a session cookie with the request","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"Because the server remembers the login request":"server-remembers-requests"}},{"prompt":"When a client sends a DELETE request to /api/posts/10/, what must the server rely on to identify the resource?","kind":"mcq","options":["The server relies on the URL in the current request only","The server looks at the previous POST request that created the resource","The server checks the user's session history for recent actions","The server uses a hidden field from the prior page"],"correct_answer":"The server relies on the URL in the current request only","problem_type":"http-statelessness","distractors":{"The server looks at the previous POST request that created the resource":"server-remembers-requests"}}]}
